description: Substrate probe: one solid-filled box of known px size. Trust anchor for box-sizing + fill paint + page geometry.
Substrate probe: a pure background-color rectangle. Trust anchor for background-color paint.

Exact-output canary: one known thick solid border. Its current failure measures PDF coordinate, stroke-state, and painted-edge encoding after the shared pdftoppm path; it does not by itself prove incorrect CSS border geometry.

Exact-output canary: two known, correctly stacked rectangles. Its current failure measures PDF coordinate serialization and painted-edge coverage after the shared pdftoppm path; it does not by itself prove incorrect block flow.

Substrate compatibility probe: a short line of ParitySans text at a known size on a baseline rule. It retains the raw Chromium comparison without treating Chromium's coordinate quantization as the sole geometry oracle.

reference.note: CSS 2.1 section 10.8.1 defines a line box from its inline boxes and does not require a CSS-pixel ceiling. Here WeasyPrint 69 and Ironpress preserve the fractional 30.230469pt line bottom, while Chromium's PDF expands it to 30.75pt. Chromium remains a compatibility canary; its exact raster is not a unique normative geometry oracle.

description: Exact-output canary: a known data:-URI PNG at a known CSS size. Its current failure measures PDF image placement encoding and painted-edge coverage after the shared pdftoppm path; it does not by itself prove incorrect CSS image sizing or decoding.
